summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on April 20, 2026, reporting a fire-related incident at the crushing circuit of its Goose Mine on April 16, 2026. The fire was extinguished with no injuries; mining operations continue on plan. The company is investigating the cause and damage, with initial assessment indicating the fire was localized to the secondary crusher screen and feed belt. No deal terms are involved. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. The filing serves as a disclosure of an incident, with further updates expected as information becomes available.
